title: Agent
description: One configurable LLM agent, persisted as agents/{id}.json (spec 009, research R-001). The apiKeyVar field stores only the NAME of the environment variable holding the API key; the key value itself is never persisted (FR-006/FR-017). File name = {id}.json.

id.description: Server-generated at creation, immutable on update (FR-003)

agentName.description: Human-readable name; unique across all agents (FR-018)

openAiCompatibleUrl.description: Absolute http/https URL of the OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (FR-019)

apiKeyVar.description: Env var NAME holding the API key; empty = no key required (FR-006). Resolved server-side via System.getenv at game launch (FR-013).

personalityPrompt.description: Free-text personality/instructions replacing the old archetype enum (FR-012)
